people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
translations.bsb: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has withheld children from you?”
translations.kjv: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
translations.asv: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
